facility.name: Boerne Kindercare
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 18 SCENIC LOOP RD, BOERNE, TX, 78006

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: One out of ten child files were reviewed. A child with a start date of 12/1/25 did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The toddler classroom had 10 children present,.  Two children were 2 yrs old and eight children were between 18-23 months old.  The classroom had one caregiver.  The classroom was over ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: Two out of ten classrooms were missing a posted evacuation route.    NOTE:  Evacuation postings were added during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The handwashing sink in a pre-school room was pulling away from the wall and loose and a cover plate for the water pipe leading into the wall was broken.    There was a  curling carpet under a sensory table in Discovery 1 room  causing a potential trip hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Doors to Restroom - Locks Out of Children's Reach: The restrooms in Preschool 1 and Preschool 2 classrooms had locks on the door handles that children could reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Doors to Restroom - Locks Out of Children's Reach (26 TAC §746.4421(1))

occurrences.finding: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits: An exit door in Toddler Rm 2 was blocked by stacked child chairs resulting in only one available emergency exit in the room.    NOTE:  The chairs were moved during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One child's vaccination record has not been updated and is missing two vaccines.    NOTE:  This is a re-cite.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The transportation binders utilized to transport children did not contain copies of emergency medical authorization forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Six out of ten child files evaluated were missing updated vaccination records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: One out of three vehicles utilized by the operation had four frayed seatbelts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Room 3 had an electrical cord from a fan mounted on the wall accessible to the children. There was also a black lamp cord hanging from a shelf behind the changing table accessible to children.    NOTE: All sunscreen and diaper cream bottles were observed stored in classroom restrooms on high shelves out of the reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The metal slide and monkey bars did not have any additional use zone surfacing added.      NOTE:  The blue spinner had been removed from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: The blue choo-choo train on the prek playground had an exposed screw.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The metal slide, monkey bars and blue spinner toy on the playgrounds had measurable loose-fill depths ranging from 0-4.5 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: Two caregivers were observed telling children "no, don't", "I am counting to 2 and you better..", meal time was over and to hurry up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two classrooms had hanging electrical cords from mounted fans on the wall.  The cords were within the reach of the children.  One classroom had a container of sunscreen accessible to the children in the room.  The bottom of a portion of the fence on the prek playground had a hole approximately 6.5 inches dug under the fence.    NOTE:  The classroom with the sunscreen container placed the items on a shelf in the restroom out of the reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: One classroom had diaper creams and ointments accessible to children in the restroom.     NOTE:  Caregiver placed the container on a shelf out of the reach of children during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: The operational policies did not include information on how they will determine extreme weather criteria.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children: The fence that backs up to the residential homes behind the operation has numerous areas of Morning Glory vines growing that are accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policy handbook did not contain information regarding the promotion of active play to include the benefit, duration for age groups, type and required clothing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: On the middle playground, the mulch under the slide and  monkey bars was compacted causing uneven depths of loose-fill material. There were two sit and spin toys that did not have any mulch around the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Sufficient Number of Toys: Infant room 3 had two out of three shelves were turned against the wall limiting access to the toys.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Sufficient Number of Toys (26 TAC §746.2405(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings: There are two areas on the front pre-school playground where the bottom of the fence can be pushed out potentially allowing a child to climb under the fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Eight children, ages 12-18 mos, were observed sitting in bucket seats having snack.  Safety straps were available in the seats but not secured around the children.    NOTE:  The caregivers put the safety straps around the children after being asked by the inspector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))
